question: Hari travels from City A to City B. If Hari drives his car at 1/8 of his normal speed, then he reaches City B 21 minutes late. Find the time (in minutes) that Hari would have taken to travel from City A to City B if he drove at his normal speed.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed ratio (New : Normal) = 1 : 8

Since distance is constant, time is inversely proportional to speed.

Time ratio (New : Normal) = 8 : 1

Difference in time ratio = 8 − 1 = 7 units.

Here, 7 units = 21 minutes ⇒ 1 unit = 3 minutes.

Normal time = 1 unit = 3 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 minutes.**
